text.tspan: Why the element was null: your script ran before the browser had parsed it.
Blocks parsing and runs at once.
The body does not exist yet, so
any time, any order. Only for
<script type="module"> is deferred automatically: that is one reason module code just works.
So there are two fixes for a null element, and defer is the better one:
defer (or type="module") on the tag, or wrap the code in document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', ...).
DOMContentLoaded fires when the DOM is ready; load waits for every image and stylesheet, which is usually much later.
